title: 民航機數位分身維護
summary: 以「將數位模型版本、量測連結與維護證據持續對照」為主線，在合成數位分身與部件歷程工作台中依序完成實體身份與模型版本綁定、漂移與真實退化分離、工況分層的模型殘差、模型和量測不確定度、部件更換後模型重置及專題交接。十單元各含機制、定量、驗證和診斷，全部算例明示為教學假設；比較情境由學員依模型建構，不是現場量測資料。
summaryEn: Follow Continuously reconcile model versions, measurement links and maintenance evidence in a Synthetic digital-twin and component-history bench, progressing through Binding physical identity and model version, Separating drift from real degradation, Condition-stratified model residuals, Model and measurement uncertainty, Model reset after component replacement, then a course handoff. Ten units each cover mechanisms, calculation, verification and diagnosis. All numbers are explicit teaching assumptions; learners construct scenario comparisons from the models, not field measurements.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.
